purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Palwal

queries.query: Palwal Haryana official cadastral parcel map GIS land records BhuNaksha Jamabandi
queries.result: Found first-party District Palwal land-records service, Haryana Web-HALRIS description, and Government of India DILRMP Palwal tehsil map-digitization dashboard. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

queries.query: पलवल हरियाणा आधिकारिक भू नक्शा जमाबंदी भू अभिलेख खसरा नक्शा
queries.result: Found the first-party Hindi District Palwal portal identifying राजस्व(भू-अभिलेख) services and the district administration land-record custodian. No anonymous parcel geometry response was exposed.

registryEvidence.basis: District Palwal's official land-record page identifies the Revenue Department, Haryana service for registration, mutation and Jamabandi and links to jamabandi.nic.in. Haryana's official Web-HALRIS page identifies the integrated land-record system and says it is implemented in all 143 tehsils. The official DILRMP Palwal dashboard reports cadastral-map inventory for Palwal tehsil.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Haryana state land-record and cadastral-map services, with official dashboard evidence for Palwal district and Palwal tehsil.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The DILRMP dashboard reports Palwal tehsil has 1,094 cadastral maps/FMBs/Tippans, 148 villages, and 1,094 digitized maps; displayed geo-referencing/linkage fields were zero in the observed response. This is inventory evidence, not a city-boundary parcel feature response.

remainingUncertainty: Palwal city and Palwal revenue tehsil/village coverage are not the same boundary. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not used to force a parcel lookup. Jamabandi timed out during the bounded anonymous request; a direct DILRMP request failed local TLS certificate-chain verification, so TLS verification was not disabled. These failures do not establish citywide absence. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe owner/address fields, or personal data were used.
